text:
Asha: quick design check on the Error Sessions filter row. want to tighten copy, keyboard nav, and export labeling before the next patch. figma frame posted: https://figma.com/file/yyy

Marco: mock looks good overall. main worry is chip wrapping on narrower widths 12 when 3+ chips appear it pushes the timeline and feels noisy. proposal: keep up to 4 visible chips, then show a summary chip like '+N' that opens a popover.

Samir: i lean toward keeping important chips visible (correlation id, request-id). those are actionable in alerts and links. if we collapse, make sure the popover preserves copy-to-clipboard and link actions. export must definitely respect active filters.

Jade: accessibility points: chips need a single entry focus for the group. recommend roving tabindex inside a container (role=toolbar) so arrow keys move between chips and Enter toggles. announce filter changes with aria-live="polite". also ensure color contrast for chip backgrounds at all states.

Marco: current build has each chip as a tab stop 12 too many stops. switch to one tab into chip group then arrows. approve roving tabindex.

Luis: export copy debate: "Export results" vs "Export filtered results". SREs expect explicit scope. my vote: "Export filtered results (CSV)" shown in the kebab menu; show a compact quick-export button inline only when filters are active.

Asha: decision: visible chips up to 4, pinned correlation-id chip always front, then '+N' summary chip opening a popover with the rest (checkboxes + quick actions). export CTA text: "Export filtered results (CSV)".

Jade: SR copy nit: chip label should include type + value, e.g. "Filter: correlation id equals 1234" for screen readers. popover items need clear focus order and keyboard labels for copy/link actions.

Samir: backend detail: when copying a trace link from chip menu include the param ?corr=xxx so links are reproducible. export endpoint should accept a filters array and include_correlation flag. i'll validate API shape and reply here.

Marco: layout: '+N' chip needs subtle focus ring and tooltip "Show hidden filters". on mobile, summary chip becomes full-width and opens a bottom sheet. add small animation for popover so it feels anchored.

design-bot: snapshot created: figma frame "error-sessions/filter-row/a11y" (v4).

Asha: next actions: Marco to update mock with roving tabindex + +N behavior; Jade to add exact SR copy and aria hints; Samir to confirm export API accepts filters payload and include_correlation param; Luis to finalize CTA placement. i'll assemble copy PR after updates. thanks! :thumbsup:

Samir: small add: add a micro tag on stacktraces when correlation id present (inline next to timestamp) so engineers can scan quickly in request drilldown. low lift, high signal.

Asha: yes please. add that to the mock as a tiny pill next to the timestamp.

Jade: also suggest aria-describedby on the export modal explaining what will be exported (record count + active filters) so SR users know scope.

Marco: will push updated frame later today and ping this thread.

Asha: closing loop after updated mock. target this in the next patch release (no infra changes).
